title: Zesty Saffron Almond Tagine
description: A sour, molten, midnight-craving Tunisian dish featuring egg wash and mushimono-steamed almonds with an anti-inflammatory twist.
instructions: Whisk together almond flour, eggs, olive oil, saffron, and lemon juice. Mix well until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour in the egg mixture and stir continuously with a spatula until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the egg mixture to a small oven-safe dish. Bake for 10 minutes or until golden brown on top.
While the eggs bake, steam almonds in boiling water for 3-4 minutes, then remove from heat and sprinkle with salt.
Drizzle extra lemon juice over both dishes and serve warm.
